meeting_title: Ridgeline Roofing Lead-to-Sign Job Process Review

items.item: Leads from Angi, website forms, and door knocking go into JobNimbus
Tasha calls the lead and books an inspection
Estimator inspects roof, builds estimate in JobNimbus, emails PDF
Follow up after estimate is up to the estimator, no system
Insurance adjuster meeting scheduling
About 120 leads a month (300 after hail)
About 45 estimates a month
Close about 30 percent
Average job about $14,000
19 of 45 estimates had no follow up
Three or four inspections a day per estimator
JobNimbus
Google Calendar
CompanyCam
Angi lead service
No follow up system after estimate
Adjuster scheduling takes 8-9 messages
Lost revenue (3 more closes = over $40,000)
Follow up day 2, 5, 10; close rate 30 to 35 percent
Missed adjuster meeting leads to supplement taking 3-4 weeks
Owner decides; Tasha and Jake see it first
Tasha pulls last quarter's estimates this week
Two-week trial on new estimates; adjuster scheduling kept as phase two
Meet Tuesday at ten with Tasha and Jake

items_numbers_missing: No system for follow-ups; estimators forget to call back customers. | 19 out of 45 estimates receive no follow-up. Potential loss of $40,000+/month if more close.

Estimator visits site | Estimator | Job Nimbus (for building estimate)
